notices.seriesRepeating: This trip repeats again. The next few months of it are back on the board.
notices.seriesCadenceSaved: Saved. The board matches the new days from here on.
notices.seriesCadenceNarrowed: Saved, but some dates already on the board are no longer part of this run. Nothing has been canceled.
notices.seriesOffCadenceCancelled: Those dates are off the public schedule and the divers booked on them are being told. Reinstate any single one from its own trip page.
notices.seriesStopped: Stopped repeating. Every date already on the board stays exactly as it is.
notices.seriesError: That series change didn’t go through. Try again from a scheduled date in the series.
